rule_errors_confirmed: Repeatedly promises to personally process cancellation and refunds immediately despite having no order tools (confirmed by anthropic and openai; flagged as minor by deepseek and qwen)
assessment: A strong, well-structured response that presents clear options with correct refund arithmetic ($76 inclusive of the $12 fee, no double-counting), makes no arrival guarantees, and maintains genuine empathy early in the conversation. Most judges converge on a high-but-not-perfect score, with the main recurring criticism being language implying immediate personal processing capability and small unsupported details like the 'unopened package' return condition. It also misses the chance to warn the customer that the refund will likely arrive after the birthday, which is relevant to their plan to buy locally.
judge_agreement: Judges agreed strongly on empathy (7-9) and resolution quality (8-10), with consensus that the options were clear and refund math was correct. The sharpest disagreement was on policy honesty: openai scored 6 for what it saw as significant capability overpromises, while google scored 10, finding no issues at all; the other three judges (anthropic, deepseek, qwen) clustered at 8, noting the same immediacy-language issue as minor rather than severe. Google was the consistent positive outlier across all criteria.
